novel_features.name: Call grep
novel_features.description: Full-text + regex search across every synced call transcript, with windowed turns of context, agent filter, and time window.
novel_features.rationale: Requires FTS5 over transcripts already pulled to disk; the API only paginates raw results and has no search endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent says 'find every call where the customer asked about cancellation,' this is the single answer no API call gives.

novel_features.name: Agent audit
novel_features.description: Joins the last 24h of calls + each call's metric results + the deployment that handled it, flagging regressions vs the prior deployment.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating four resources offline (agents, deployments, calls, metric_results) — no single endpoint produces this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent wants a single 'is my voice agent regressing right now' verdict.

novel_features.name: Deployment diff
novel_features.description: Side-by-side diff of prompt, voice, model, and config between any two deployments of the same agent.
novel_features.rationale: Needs both deployments resolved into one renderer; the API returns one deployment per call.
novel_features.example: cartesia-pp-cli agents diff agent_42 --from dep_prev --to dep_curr --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent says 'why did this start failing after my last push?'

novel_features.name: Metric trend
novel_features.description: Bucketed pass-rate or score-mean for any LLM-judge metric over time, sliced by deployment.
novel_features.rationale: Joins metric_results with the deployment timeline locally; the API paginates raw results only.
novel_features.example: cartesia-pp-cli metrics trend metric_pass_rate --bucket day --agent agent_42 --since 30d --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent wants to know 'is quality going up or down per release?'

novel_features.name: Since-when feed
novel_features.description: Every call plus every flagged metric result on a given agent since a timestamp, in one chronological feed.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed aggregation across calls and metric_results — no single API endpoint returns this combined view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent comes back from a break and asks 'what happened on my line while I was away?'

novel_features.name: Bad-call hunter
novel_features.description: Surfaces the lowest-scored calls across all agents in one window, with transcript snippets.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-agent ranking from local metric_results joined to call transcripts — the API does not rank cross-agent.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent says 'show me the worst things our voice agents said this week.'

novel_features.name: Voice changelog
novel_features.description: Voices created, updated, deleted since the last sync, with metadata diffs.
novel_features.rationale: Needs historical local snapshots; the API returns only current state.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to know which voices changed before a deployment.

novel_features.name: Voice picker
novel_features.description: Free-text style match ("warm female, mid-pitch, Spanish") against locally cached voice catalog with structured filters.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 over local voice catalog + filters; no API search endpoint exists.
novel_features.example: cartesia-pp-cli voices find 'warm female mid-pitch' --lang es --gender female --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to pick a voice from a description, not an id.

novel_features.name: Transcript SQL
novel_features.description: Read-only SELECT over the local SQLite store — agents, calls, transcripts, metrics, deployments.
novel_features.rationale: Composable read surface on synced data; unique to local-store CLIs.
novel_features.example: cartesia-pp-cli sql "SELECT id, summary FROM calls ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 20" --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when no canned subcommand fits the question.

novel_features.name: Cost estimate
novel_features.description: Estimates credit cost for a planned operation (fine-tune, localize) from local usage history.
novel_features.rationale: Combines /usage/credits history with a planned operation; no single endpoint estimates pre-spend.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before committing to a billable operation an agent is about to kick off.

narrative.headline: Manage Cartesia voice agents, deployments, calls, metrics, and voices from the terminal — with a local SQLite mirror that makes agent grep, drift, and audit possible.
narrative.value_prop: Every Cartesia endpoint as a typed command, plus the offline joins the API can't do in one shot: deployment diff, transcript grep, metric trends, agent audit. Designed for AI agents and humans alike.
narrative.auth_narrative: Cartesia ships two Bearer schemes on the same header: long-lived API keys for backend automation and short-lived JWT access tokens (obtained from POST /access-token with TTS or STT grants) for browser/edge clients. `auth set-token` stores the API key in OS-appropriate config; `auth access-token` mints a JWT.

quickstart.comment: Store your Cartesia API key so every subsequent call is authenticated.
Verifies auth, base URL, and Cartesia-Version header before any real work.
Pulls agents, voices, deployments, metrics, datasets into the local store so the compound commands work.
Once synced, this returns every transcript containing 'cancel' across all agents -- no extra API calls.
Joins calls, metric_results, and deployments locally for a single regression verdict.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `cartesia-pp-cli auth status`; if missing, `auth set-token` or `export CARTESIA_API_KEY=sk_car_...`.
Set `CARTESIA_API_VERSION` env var to the date string from `cartesia-pp-cli status` (currently 2025-04-16).
Calls aren't synced until you run `sync --resource calls --full`. The grep is offline-first.
Reduce concurrency: WebSocket multiplexes contexts but caps per connection. Use --max-contexts to bound.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for cartesia-pp-cli when iterating on a production Cartesia voice agent: tweaking prompts, watching deployments roll out, grepping call transcripts for failure modes, attaching LLM-judge metrics, or pulling regression reports. The local SQLite mirror is what makes the compound commands fast and offline-friendly.

recipes.title: Find calls where the agent misheard a date
recipes.command: cartesia-pp-cli calls grep yesterday --agent agent_42 --turns 1 --json --select id,start_time,agent_id
recipes.explanation: FTS-backed search over local transcripts with dotted --select so the response stays under one screen.

recipes.title: Audit yesterday's deployment for regressions
recipes.explanation: Joins calls + metric_results + deployments offline; flags any metric that dropped more than 10% from the prior deployment.

recipes.title: Pick a Spanish voice from a description
recipes.command: cartesia-pp-cli voices find warm --lang es --gender female --json
recipes.explanation: FTS5 + structured filters over the locally cached voice catalog; returns the top match in agent-ready JSON.

recipes.title: Estimate credits before kicking off a fine-tune
recipes.explanation: Compares the planned fine-tune to your local usage history so you don't pay for an experiment you'd skip.

recipes.title: Find the worst-scored calls this week
recipes.explanation: Cross-agent ranking from local metric_results joined to call transcripts; surfaces the lowest scorers without touching the API.
